components.name: Primary Button

components.html: <button class="ds-button-primary" type="button"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M20 11a8.1 8.1 0 0 0-15.5-2M4 4v5h5"/><path d="M4 13a8.1 8.1 0 0 0 15.5 2M20 20v-5h-5"/></svg>Format JSON</button>
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; border: 1px solid var(--coral, #e84b3c); border-radius: 9px; padding: 0 14px; color: white; background: var(--coral, #e84b3c); font: 700 .78rem/1.45 var(--font-sans, Arial, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover, .ds-button-primary:active { border-color: var(--coral-dark, #cc392d); background: var(--coral-dark, #cc392d); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--coral, #e84b3c) 72%, white); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A supporting or reversible action beside the primary operation.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dfe3eb); border-radius: 9px; padding: 0 14px; color: var(--ink, #252832); background: var(--surface, #fff); font: 700 .78rem/1.45 var(--font-sans, Arial, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong, #cfd5e0); background: var(--surface-soft, #fafbfe); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--coral, #e84b3c) 72%, white); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-secondary:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Focal Search
components.description: The widest and most elevated control on catalogue surfaces.
components.css: .ds-search { width: min(100%, 1050px); height: 58px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 0 14px 0 17px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #cfd5e0); border-radius: 13px; color: #7c8290; background: var(--surface, #fff); box-shadow: 0 8px 26px rgba(35,42,58,.08); transition: border-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease, transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--coral, #e84b3c); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--coral-soft, #fff0ed), 0 12px 32px rgba(35,42,58,.1); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; width: 100%; border: 0; outline: 0; color: var(--ink, #252832); background: transparent; font: 400 1rem/1.65 var(--font-sans, Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-search kbd { padding: 4px 7px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dfe3eb); border-radius: 6px; color: #747b88; background: var(--surface-soft, #fafbfe); box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 var(--line, #dfe3eb); font: 400 .72rem/1 var(--font-sans, Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-search-label { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); }

components.name: Category Filter
components.description: A compact supporting control for narrowing catalogue results.
components.css: .ds-filter { border: 1px solid var(--line, #dfe3eb); padding: 8px 13px; border-radius: 9px; color: #565c69; background: var(--surface, #fff); font: 680 .78rem/1.45 var(--font-sans, Arial, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, background 150ms ease; } .ds-filter:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong, #cfd5e0); color: var(--ink, #252832); } .ds-filter:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--coral, #e84b3c) 72%, white); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Selected Category Filter
components.description: The inverted active state for the current catalogue category.
components.css: .ds-filter-selected { border: 1px solid var(--ink, #252832); padding: 8px 13px; border-radius: 9px; color: white; background: var(--ink, #252832); font: 680 .78rem/1.45 var(--font-sans, Arial, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter-selected:hover { background: #343844; } .ds-filter-selected:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--coral, #e84b3c) 72%, white); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-utility-card { min-height: 136px; position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 14px; padding: 18px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dfe3eb); border-radius: 14px; color: var(--ink, #252832); background: var(--surface, #fff); text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font-sans, Arial, sans-serif); transition: border-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease, transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-utility-card:hover { border-color: #cbd1dc; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(35,42,58,.08); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-utility-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--coral, #e84b3c) 72%, white); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-tool-icon { width: 40px; height: 40px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 10px; color: white; background: var(--coral, #e84b3c); } .ds-card-copy { display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-card-copy strong { font-size: .92rem; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -.012em; } .ds-card-copy small { color: var(--ink-soft, #606673); font-size: .75rem; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-card-arrow { position: absolute; top: 18px; right: 15px; color: #9aa0ad; }

components.name: Compact Tool Row

components.css: .ds-tool-row { min-height: 82px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 36px minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 13px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dfe3eb); border-radius: 14px; color: var(--ink, #252832); background: var(--surface, #fff); text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font-sans, Arial, sans-serif); transition: border-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease, transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-tool-row:hover { border-color: #cbd1dc; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(35,42,58,.08); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-tool-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--coral, #e84b3c) 72%, white); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-row-icon { width: 36px; height: 36px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 9px; color: white; background: var(--blue, #3977be); } .ds-row-copy { min-width: 0; display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-row-copy strong { font-size: .92rem; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-row-copy small { overflow: hidden; color: var(--ink-soft, #606673); font-size: .75rem; line-height: 1.45; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-row-arrow { color: #9aa0ad; }

components.css: .ds-nav { min-height: 64px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 28px; padding: 0 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #dfe3eb); color: var(--ink, #252832); background: rgba(255,255,255,.96); font-family: var(--font-sans, Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-wordmark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: inherit; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 820; letter-spacing: -.02em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-mark { width: 34px; height: 34px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 9px; color: white; background: var(--coral, #e84b3c); } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 28px; } .ds-nav-links a { position: relative; padding: 22px 0; color: #474c58; font-size: .88rem; font-weight: 650; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-links a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 13px; left: 0; height: 2px; background: var(--coral, #e84b3c); transform: scaleX(0); transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-nav-links a:hover::after, .ds-nav-links a:focus-visible::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--coral, #e84b3c) 72%, white); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Tool Workspace
components.description: A two-pane local-processing workspace with inset technical fields and compact actions.
components.css: .ds-workspace { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dfe3eb); border-radius: 14px; color: var(--ink, #252832); background: var(--surface, #fff); font-family: var(--font-sans, Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-workspace > header { min-height: 60px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 13px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #dfe3eb); } .ds-workspace > header span { color: var(--success, #18743d); font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-workspace-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } .ds-workspace-grid label { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-workspace-grid label + label { border-left: 1px solid var(--line, #dfe3eb); } .ds-workspace-grid label > span { padding: 9px 13px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #dfe3eb); color: var(--ink-soft, #606673); background: var(--surface-soft, #fafbfe); font-size: .73rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-workspace textarea { min-height: 150px; border: 0; outline: 0; padding: 16px; color: var(--ink, #252832); background: #fbfcfe; font: 400 .8rem/1.7 var(--font-mono, monospace); resize: vertical; } .ds-workspace textarea:focus { background: white; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--coral-soft, #fff0ed); } .ds-workspace footer { padding: 14px 17px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #dfe3eb); } .ds-workspace footer button { min-height: 40px; border: 1px solid var(--coral, #e84b3c); border-radius: 9px; padding: 0 14px; color: white; background: var(--coral, #e84b3c); font-weight: 720; cursor: pointer; } .ds-workspace footer button:hover { border-color: var(--coral-dark, #cc392d); background: var(--coral-dark, #cc392d); } .ds-workspace footer button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--coral, #e84b3c) 72%, white); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Search First is a direct utility library with a personal author, not a portfolio hero with tools attached. A cool canvas, white work surfaces, compact sans typography, and dense repeated rows make the site feel immediately useful. Florian's authorship appears through the wordmark, restrained introduction, projects, and writing while search remains the clearest route into the product.

The system is bright, precise, and familiar without becoming generic. Coral identifies primary actions and active attention; small violet, green, blue, and amber tiles sort tools into functional families. Rounded rectangles, quiet cool borders, and measured gaps create a steady catalogue rhythm that can scale beyond fifty tools without turning into a decorative card collage.

The shipped implementation is the token authority. The approved composition is `.impeccable/mocks/search-led-catalogue.webp` (Straight Utility Catalogue, seed `9c978054`), and the finish review verdict is **ship** with no material fixes. No raster media ships in the interface; the visual system is semantic HTML, CSS, and inline Lucide geometry.
keyCharacteristics: A cool off-white canvas beneath crisp white utility surfaces.
Coral reserved for primary action, focus, and directional emphasis.
Compact Public Sans throughout the interface; JetBrains Mono only inside technical fields.
Dense, responsive catalogue grids with one clear search control above them.
Multicolor functional glyph tiles that make repeated tool rows faster to scan.
Gentle rounded rectangles, cool 1px borders, and soft state-driven elevation.

rules.name: The Coral Attention Rule
rules.body: Coral marks the next action or the current point of attention; keep it out of large backgrounds and do not assign it to every card.

rules.name: The Functional Tile Rule
rules.body: Violet, green, blue, and amber live in small glyph tiles, badges, or explicit states; they classify repeated content rather than compete as page-level accents.

rules.name: The State Is Semantic Rule
rules.body: Success and danger colors always accompany readable text or status structure and never carry meaning alone.

rules.name: The One-Sans Rule
rules.body: Use Public Sans for identity, headings, prose, navigation, and controls; hierarchy comes from scale and weight, not a decorative display family.

rules.name: The Monospace Boundary Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono belongs inside technical input, output, and code metadata only; do not use it as a general developer aesthetic.

rules.name: The Search Leads Rule
rules.body: On catalogue surfaces, the widest and most visually elevated control is search; filters and sorting remain compact supporting controls directly around the results.

rules.name: The Density Scales Rule
rules.body: Preserve the information order while reducing column count; do not remove search, categories, names, or result feedback to make mobile fit.

rules.name: The Quiet-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Cards and workspaces rest on borders and tonal contrast; shadows appear only for the focal search or an interactive state.

rules.name: The Nested Radius Rule
rules.body: Outer containers receive the largest corners, controls and tiles step down, and small badges step down again so nested shapes feel intentional.

rules.name: The Rectangle Rule
rules.body: Filters, buttons, search, cards, and fields stay compact rounded rectangles; avoid oversized pills that imply a softer consumer-social product.

dos: Do place direct search and filtering ahead of profile storytelling on utility catalogue surfaces.
Do use white cards, cool 1px borders, and compact `8–12px` grid gaps to make large result sets scan quickly.
Do reserve coral for the next action, focus, and a few directional cues.
Do use the multicolor glyph tiles consistently to classify tool families.
Do preserve explicit labels, visible focus, live result feedback, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't add an oversized profile hero, portrait-led composition, or atmospheric metaphor that delays the first useful action.
Don't turn every card into a floating panel; the system is border-led and only lifts on interaction.
Don't spread violet, green, blue, and amber across page backgrounds; keep them functional and contained.
Don't use monospace outside technical work or replace the compact sans hierarchy with a decorative display face.
Don't replace the rounded-rectangle vocabulary with pervasive pills, sharp boxes, or ornamental geometry.
